about: RFC replayed-tool-results-carry-their-time §6.1. Shape of the 2026-11-14 code-reviewer-uncle seed: the carried range opened with the runtime's tail-window preamble, then the lane call and a lane result appended 14398 s before the session started, observing a lane that was down then and is up now. Texts are written for the eval; the goal is read from goal_file. The real call message also carried agent_core.reasoning_source.v2 metadata naming the GLM provider; the eval leaves it out rather than invent provider ids. An object {"$seconds_before": N} is a time N seconds before the reference: session start for history, the call for a mock result.
